title: Playboy January 2006 Lisa Guerrero Mark Cuban Beckinsale Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Small crease near the top-left of the front cover, light edge and spine wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, January 2006 Holiday Anniversary Issue. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: sportscaster Lisa Guerrero.

Cover features: Lisa Guerrero - Best Damn Sports Beauty; The Playboy Interview with Mavericks owner Mark Cuban; 20Q with Kate Beckinsale; Car Wars - Detroit's battle for the 21st century; John Updike, Jay McInerney, Bruce Jay Friedman, GM's Robert Lutz, Shel Silverstein; colorful tuxedos; cars of the year; and the Playmate Review.

Back cover: Chivas Regal whisky ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
